title: Encrypt Service State
description: Encrypts any pipeline value using AES-256-GCM and emits a self-contained base64 ciphertext string. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/encrypt)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

secret.description: Shared secret used to derive the encryption key

method.description: Encryption method (only AES-GCM is currently supported)
